Static Front-End Website

A website whose pages are delivered as prepared files, with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other assets handling what visitors see and use.

  • Web Development
  • Technology

Context

The files can be written directly or generated during a build. A browser can still run JavaScript to search, filter, animate, or fetch data after loading a static page.

Aaron Schlossberg’s Universe uses this approach. Its build prepares the Compendium pages, and the browser adds features such as filtering and copying a share link.

Examples

  • A prebuilt glossary can display every definition immediately and use JavaScript to narrow the list as someone types.

References
